description: Defines template classes and functions for sequencing data results in PyTorch's data loader, including NoSequencer and OrderedSequencer implementations.

classes.name: Sequencer
classes.description: Abstract base class for data sequencers that yield results for a DataLoader.

classes.name: NoSequencer
classes.description: A sequencer that returns results directly without enforcing any order.

classes.name: OrderedSequencer
classes.description: A sequencer that buffers and returns results in order of their sequence number.

methods.name: buffer_contains_result
methods.description: Checks if the buffer contains any result with a value.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next result in the sequence, implemented differently in each subclass.

methods.name: buffer
methods.description: Accesses the buffer at a specific index modulo its size.
